LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_CavesWithLake.des: An underground lake connected to a river. You can gather some nearby resources before detouring, even if there's nothing particularly special.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Worm.label: Insect Nest
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Worm.description: The drilling machine has dug near an insect nest.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_FairyRing.label: Mushroom Ring
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_FairyRing.descrip: The drilling machine has dug into a mushroom ring! Go gather these precious natural fungi.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Lode.label: Underground Vein
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Lode.description: The drilling machine has dug near an underground mineral vein. You can disembark to mine it.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_GuerrillaBase.des: The drilling machine has dug near a Ratkin guerrilla outpost.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Flesh.label: Fleshbeast Cave
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Flesh.description: The drilling machine has dug into the fleshbeasts' lair. Note: Killing the mother beast will cause the cave to collapse.
